checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Realistic wooden cabin among pine trees at dawn
must.why: Photoreal log cabin, pines, warm low sun and mist.

must.item: Camera advances smoothly toward front door
must.why: Cabin grows steadily larger and the door stays centered across the frames.

must.item: Foreground trees shift relative to cabin showing parallax
must.why: Foreground trunks move outward and leave the frame as the camera pushes in.
Cabin and trees look consistent across frames; no visible scene change.
854x480 is 16:9; the assistant says there is no sound.

faults.what: By the last frame the cabin fills the frame and the foreground trees have almost all left it, so the foreground effect fades at the end.
The cabin's roof and eaves shift a little between frames, which is expected from the push-in but not perfectly stable.

summary: A realistic dawn cabin among pines with a smooth push-in toward the door and clear foreground parallax; there are no major problems.
